We have template 1914385. Need to propose retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O.

We need to apply this template in retrosynthetic direction (i.e., break target into precursors). The template's retro_smarts: left side is product? Actually retro_smarts_template shows product>>reactants? The template appears to be forward reaction? The retro_smarts_template is given as product>>reactants? Let's examine: The template string: '[C;D1;H3:1]-[#8:2]-[C:3](=[O;D1;H0:4])-[C@@;H0;D4;+0:5]12-[C:9]-[C:7](=[O;D1;H0:8])-[C@@H;D3;+0:6]-1-[CH2;D2;+0:13]-[CH;D2;+0:12]=[CH;D2;+0:11]-[CH2;D2;+0:10]-2>>[C;D1;H3:1]-[#8:2]-[C:3](=[O;D1;H0:4])-[C;H0;D3;+0:5]1=[CH;D2;+0:6]-[C:7](=[O;D1;H0:8])-[C:9]-1.[CH2;D1;+0:10]=[CH;D2;+0:11]-[CH;D2;+0:12]=[CH2;D1;+0:13]'

So left side is product (target) and right side are two fragments (reactants). So applying retrosynthesis: target -> two precursors.

Thus we need to apply template to target SMILES to get precursors. Use apply_template tool.
